description: This file contains analytics-related functions for the Mattermost server, including gathering system metrics, user activity, and webhook statistics.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing analytics and user management functions.

methods.name: GetAnalytics
methods.description: Retrieves various analytics data based on the specified name and team ID.

methods.name: GetAnalyticsForSupportPacket
methods.description: Retrieves standard analytics data for support packet generation.

methods.name: getAnalytics
methods.description: Internal method to fetch specific analytics data based on parameters.

methods.name: getStandardAnalytics
methods.description: Gathers core system metrics such as user counts, channel counts, and activity.

methods.name: getBotPostCountsAnalytics
methods.description: Fetches post count analytics for bots.

methods.name: getPostCountsAnalytics
methods.description: Fetches post count analytics for all posts.

methods.name: getUserCountsWithPostsAnalytics
methods.description: Retrieves user counts with posts, optionally skipping intensive queries.

methods.name: getExtraCountsAnalytics
methods.description: Gathers additional system metrics like webhook counts, commands, sessions, and storage.

methods.name: GetRecentlyActiveUsersForTeam
methods.description: Returns a map of recently active users in a team.

methods.name: GetRecentlyActiveUsersForTeamPage
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of recently active users in a team, with optional view restrictions.

methods.name: GetNewUsersForTeamPage
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of new users in a team, with optional view restrictions.
